Phoenix Car Service

Scottsdale Sprinters runs a private car service across metro Phoenix: a professional chauffeur, a reserved vehicle and a written confirmation, booked either as a one-way transfer or by the hour as directed. Published rates are $125–$295/hr on a 4-hour minimum, so a Phoenix car service starts at $500 before tax in the Luxury SUV (Suburban) and $1,180 in the Maybach Jet Sprinter. Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout and a 50% deposit holds the date.

Last updated: September 18, 2026

What does a car service in Phoenix cost?

The current published hourly rates for the car-class vehicles are $125–$295/hr on a 4-hour minimum, so the starting total before tax is the rate times that minimum: $500 for the Luxury SUV (Suburban), $580 for either executive Sprinter, $780 for the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter and $1,180 for the Maybach Jet Sprinter. That arithmetic is the whole pricing model: published hourly rate times billable hours, never below the 4-hour minimum, plus Arizona sales tax of 8% at checkout. You reserve the vehicle, not a seat: two riders and 14 riders pay the same for the same Executive Black Sprinter. Split across every seat at the minimum, that is roughly $83 a head in the Luxury SUV (Suburban) and $41 in the Executive Black Sprinter — an even split of the pre-tax fare, for planning only. A 5-hour evening is $625 and $725. Check availability and request a current quote for your own date.

What is a private car service, and how is it different from a black car or town car service?

Three names for one product at Scottsdale Sprinters: a chauffeur, a vehicle reserved for you, and a price set from the published rate grid before you travel. "Black car" and "town car" describe an executive sedan-class ride; what arrives here is the Luxury SUV (Suburban) or an executive Sprinter, black on black, with a chauffeur at the wheel. Nothing in the price changes with the label. A luxury car service, an executive car service and a chauffeur service in Phoenix are all quoted from the same $125–$295/hr grid, on the same 4-hour minimum, with the same 50% deposit and the same Arizona sales tax of 8%. The only real fork is how you book the time, and that section is next.

Which vehicles does a Phoenix car service arrive in?

Five car-class vehicles, seating 6 to 14 between them, and the rule is the smallest one that clears the real headcount and the real bag count. Up to 6 passengers take the Luxury SUV (Suburban) at $125 per hour — its own catalog entry is written for any point-to-point charter with a chauffeur, for up to six: airport, dinner, the meeting, the show, the wedding, the day out. Every event we can think of. Up to 8 take the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter at $195 per hour and up to 9 the Maybach Jet Sprinter at $295 per hour. Up to 14 take the Executive Black Sprinter or the Executive White Sprinter, both at $145 per hour. Above 14 passengers this becomes a coach booking, priced from a different part of the grid — the charter guide linked below carries those rates. Seated capacity is a planning limit: confirm luggage and any accessibility requirement with the reservations team in writing.

How much luggage fits?

Bags decide the vehicle as often as seats do. The Luxury SUV (Suburban) has room for 10 bags; the Executive Black Sprinter and the Executive White Sprinter each have room for 40 bags; the Maybach Jet Sprinter carries 4 checked bags and 8 carry-ons. The Maybach Shuttle Sprinter is the exception: built for moving a small group around town rather than for a baggage haul, it carries a bag count we confirm in writing rather than a published cap. Give the bag count with the headcount.

Point-to-point transfer or hourly as directed — which do I book?

A transfer is one move, A to B, at a published trip price — $225 to $550 one way by vehicle, flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off and priced from the drive beyond that with the empty return included, and no hours to estimate. Hourly as directed reserves the vehicle and chauffeur for a block you control, from the 4-hour minimum upward, and stops inside it are already paid for. Book the transfer for one movement with no waiting: an arrival, a departure, a single drop. Book hourly when the vehicle stays with you — a meeting that runs long, a multi-stop evening, a day of showings. On a transfer, each added stop is $50, outbound and return alike. On an hourly booking stops cost nothing extra, and time beyond the block bills at the same rate, not a penalty rate. Not sure which fits? Give the itinerary and request a current quote both ways.

What is included in the rate?

Included: a professional chauffeur, the reserved vehicle for the booked hours, fuel and tolls, your itinerary's stops and bottled water. Added at checkout: Arizona sales tax of 8%, the 50% deposit and optional gratuity. No booking fee, no service charge, no fuel surcharge. Three house rules carry a fee: $1,500 for smoking or vaping, $450 to deep-clean an excessive spill and $450 for a biohazard clean; an added stop on a transfer is $50. Outside the rate: parking or site access billed directly, event permits, meals. Every booking is chauffeured: there is no self-drive or unchauffeured rental in the catalog.

Where in metro Phoenix do you pick up?

Scottsdale Sprinters runs car service across the published service area: Phoenix, Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Cave Creek and San Tan Valley. The published hourly rate is the same in every one of them, so a Chandler pickup is booked exactly like a Phoenix, Tempe, Mesa, Glendale or Paradise Valley one. Distance is not billed separately on an hourly booking: the driving time between stops sits inside the hours you reserved. On a transfer the published price covers the route you gave and is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off, while a longer route is priced from the drive, with the empty return included and the basis shown on the quote.

What do Phoenix clients book a car service for?

Four things, repeatedly. Corporate and executive travel is the largest — a client run, a board visit, a roadshow of meetings across the metro — and the corporate transportation page carries that offer in full. Airport arrivals and departures are the second, and they have their own pages, linked below. Third, evenings out, where the vehicle stays with you for the booked hours instead of being re-summoned between stops. Fourth, day trips out of the Valley on the same hourly basis; the tour pages carry the itineraries.

Do you do airport pickups at Sky Harbor?

Yes. The Phoenix service-area page names Phoenix Sky Harbor International (PHX) and Scottsdale Airport (SCF) from its own ZIP data, and an airport move is booked either as a one-way transfer or inside an hourly block. The meet point, the terminal and the flight-tracking detail are answered on the two airport pages linked below, not repeated here. Give the flight number when you request the quote.

How is a reserved black car service different from an on-demand ride?

The difference is what is fixed before you travel on our side. A Scottsdale Sprinters reservation names the vehicle class, assigns a professional chauffeur, and carries a written confirmation with your date, pickup address, itinerary and price on it. The vehicle stays reserved for your booked hours and does not leave between stops. The price comes from the published rate grid at the moment you book — hourly rate times billable hours, or the transfer price — plus Arizona sales tax of 8% and the 50% deposit, with no other surcharge on the base fare. Nothing here describes any other company's product.

How do I reserve a car service in Phoenix?

Four steps: pick the vehicle and the shape of the booking, request a quote with your date and full itinerary, confirm with a 50% deposit, and the balance is charged to the card on file 48 hours before pickup. The pricing page carries the rates and the availability check; you can also call or text (623) 986-6339 or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com. A quote needs the date and time, the pickup and final drop addresses, every stop between them, the passenger count, the bag count, and whether you want a transfer or an hourly block. Name the vehicle you have in mind, or give the numbers and the reservations team will name the smallest one that fits. Deposit, balance and cancellation terms are published in full on the policies page linked below.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a car service cost in Phoenix?

What is the difference between a private car service, a black car service and a town car service in Phoenix?

Is there an hourly minimum on a Phoenix car service?

What is the difference between a transfer and booking a car service by the hour?

SUV or Sprinter — which do I book for six or more passengers?
